name: Gitea
description: Self-hosted Git service with a web UI, issues, and pull requests.
about: Git hosting with repositories, issues, pull requests, and package registries. Runs the rootless image, so the service runs as an unprivileged user. The first start opens a setup page where you confirm the database, SQLite by default, and create the admin account.

variables.label: Data folder
variables.description: Git repositories, the database, and uploads.

variables.label: Config folder
variables.description: Stores app.ini and the secrets Gitea generates at install.

variables.label: SSH port
variables.description: Host port for Git over SSH, unpublished when blank.

variables.label: Domain
variables.description: IP address or hostname used in clone URLs, localhost when blank.

variables.label: Allow self-registration
variables.description: Allow visitors to create accounts, otherwise an admin must add them after initial setup.

variables.label: Base URL
variables.description: Public URL used for links and HTTP clones, especially behind a reverse proxy.

variables.label: Require sign-in to view
variables.description: Require sign-in to view pages or use the API.

variables.label: Git LFS
variables.description: Serve large files with Git LFS. Objects are stored in the data folder.

variables.label: Timezone
variables.description: IANA name used for timestamps in Gitea's log output.

variables.label: Run as user
variables.description: Numeric UID:GID, default 1000:1000, with write access to the data and config folders.
